channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Flagler County Sheriff’s Office deputies de-escalate dangerous armed individual
item.description: The suspect, who was having a severe mental health crisis, pointed a weapon and deputies.

item.title: Bill requiring English-only driver license tests clears Florida House panel
item.description: HB 1307 would prohibit 'unauthorized aliens' from getting any licenses the state Department of Financial Services issues, such as those related to insurance.

item.title: Volusia, Flagler law enforcement agencies reimbursed by Florida for supporting ICE operations
item.description: Florida's chief financial officer presented a total of $1.7 million to six local law enforcement agencies. The FCSO received the largest sum of funds, at over $725,000.

item.title: Flagler Cares Help-A-Thon to be broadcast March 6 across four Flagler Broadcasting radio stations
item.description: The 'Neighbors Helping Neighbors' fundraising event will highlight monetary donations and donated professional services.

item.title: $2.375 million settlement agreement in Holland Park splash pad lawsuit to be presented to City Council
item.description: The Palm Coast City Council on Feb. 17 will review the proposed settlement resolving litigation related to the original construction of the splash pad.

item.title: Samadhi Wildlife in Ormond secures 10 acres for new sanctuary, launches fundraiser to help construction
item.description: The nonprofit seeks to raise $150,000 to begin constructing a new wildlife sanctuary, as the threat of eviction continues to loom.

item.title: Flagler Beach commissioner seeks termination of city manager
item.description: Tensions rise during Feb. 12 meeting after vice chair calls for accountability review and commissioner moves to terminate city manager’s contract.

item.title: Former School Board member Trevor Tucker joins the race for the District 4 seat
item.description: After losing an election for the first time in 2022, Tucker will run again against incumbent Christy Chong and challenger Ron Long.

item.title: The origins and history of Valentine's Day in Florida
item.description: The Valentine’s Day holiday replaced the ancient Roman pagan festival of Lupercalia, which was held annually in mid-February and originated around the 6th century B.C.

item.title: Beachfront condo in Ormond-by-the-Sea sells for $850K
item.description: Built in 2006, the beachfront condo is a 3/3 and has 2,515 square feet.
